items.description_en: The adidas Predator Elite FG: built for control Some players win games with pace. You win them with the touch nobody else can make. The adidas Predator Elite FG is built for that player, the one who sees the pass two moves early and has the precision to land it. This is the senior, top-tier adidas Predator cleats, the head of the brand's control-and-strike line. From Beckham's free kicks to Zidane's dragbacks, the adidas Predator name has belonged to footballers who think with the ball at their feet, and the Road to Glory Pack carries that lineage into 2026. How the adidas Predator Elite cleat controls the ball The grip is the whole point. Nanostrike+ pairs a soft, featherlight mesh with rubber grip elements across the strike zone, the part of the cleat that meets the ball when you drive a pass or bend a shot. That texture grabs the ball on contact, so a driven through-ball sits down instead of skidding and a curled effort holds its line in the wet. Powerspine runs through the midfoot to keep you stable when you plant and strike, and the Strikeframe plate stays light through every stride. Who the Predator is suited for This is a cleat for the controlling attacker and the deep playmaker, the No. 10 who picks the lock on a low block and the No. 8 who switches play. If your game runs on first touch and precise striking rather than raw sprint speed, the adidas Predator Elite is in your corner. Speed merchants who live on the last defender's shoulder lean toward the adidas F50; control players choose the adidas Predator Elite FG. Compare tiers across the adidas Predator collection . adidas Predator Elite FG Product Details Tier: senior Elite, the top of the Predator line Surface: firm ground (FG), built for natural grass and well-kept pitches Upper: synthetic and textile, Primeknit Striking tech: NANOSTRIKE+ mesh with rubber grip elements Stability: Powerspine midfoot support Plate: Strikeframe lightweight full-length, non-removable studs Closure: laces with a floating tongue Sockliner: synthetic Fit: regular Weight: 6.9 oz (195.3 g) Colorway: Solar Turbo / Thermal Chrome / Core Black Fit Notes The adidas Predator Elite runs regular through the forefoot and true to size for most players. If you sit between sizes, go down the half size for a snug, locked-in feel. The laces and floating tongue let you dial in the wrap, so a wider midfoot can loosen off without losing the heel. Care and Maintenance Air-dry after every match, away from heat, sun, and dryers Stuff with newspaper to pull moisture and hold the shape Brush off dried grass and dirt before storing Wipe the Primeknit upper with a damp cloth; no machine washing Store at room temperature, around 70°F (21°C) FAQs about the Predator Elite FG Are the adidas Predator Elite FG laced or laceless? These are the laced version. The Predator Elite FG uses a lace closure with a floating tongue, so you control the wrap and lockdown over the laces. adidas also makes a laceless Predator Elite for players who want a clean striking surface with no laces; this SKU is the laced build. Do the Predator Elite cleats run true to size? For most players, yes. The adidas Predator Elite FG runs true to size with a snug regular forefoot. If you have a narrow foot or want a tighter feel, go down half a size. Can I wear these on artificial grass? The FG plate is built for natural grass and well-maintained pitches. For dedicated artificial grass, the AG version with shorter, more numerous studs is the better choice and protects your knees and ankles on the firmer surface. What makes the Predator different from the adidas F50? The Predator is a control-and-strike cleat: the Nanostrike+ grip elements help with precise passing and bent shots. The F50 is a speed cleat built around acceleration and a lightweight feel. Pick the Predator if your game runs on touch and precision; pick the F50 if it runs on pace.

items.description_en: The Predator: built for a young striker Every team has that one kid who wants the ball near goal and would rather try the shot than play it safe. The adidas Junior Predator League is for that kid: the Predator's control-and-contact identity, scaled to a price and fit that work for a growing player. The Road to Glory Pack colorway, Solar Turbo with Thermal Chrome and Core Black, stands out on a gray Saturday. What gives it the control feel The headline is the fold-over tongue. It covers the laces for a clean, flat strike surface, so a kid learning to shoot with power gets steadier contact. A soft Nanostrike mesh upper with a haptic overlay adds grip, and the Strikeframe plate holds firm-ground traction. It's the real adidas predator road to glory build. See the full adidas Predator lineup to compare it against the senior models. Who these are for This is the cleat for a competitive grass player who lives at the attacking end. League tier means a true Predator build at a parent-friendly price, the smart adidas predator youth pick when Elite money feels steep for feet that might grow by fall. For matching gear, see the Road to Glory Pack . adidas Junior Predator League Product Details Tier: League (mid-tier value) Surface: Firm Ground (FG), natural grass Upper: Nanostrike synthetic mesh with haptic overlay Striking surface: iconic fold-over tongue Plate: Strikeframe full-length Closure: laces Weight: 5.4 oz (154 g) Colorway: Solar Turbo / Thermal Chrome / Core Black Sizing: youth, US 1 to 5.5 Fit Notes This adidas predator youth cleat runs true to size. Leave a thumb's width at the toe for growing room, but don't go past half a size or the foot slides and the control feel is lost. The regular fit suits a standard to wider junior foot. Care and Maintenance Air-dry after every match; stuff with newspaper to pull moisture and hold the shape Keep away from dryers, radiators, and direct sun, which warp the plate Brush off grass and dirt before they go back in the bag The synthetic Nanostrike upper needs only a soft brush and a damp wipe, no conditioner Fold the tongue back after play to keep its shape FAQs about the Junior Predator League What does the fold-over tongue actually do? It folds across the top of the foot and covers the laces, leaving a clean, flat strike surface. For a young player learning to shoot and pass with power, that means more consistent contact with the ball and fewer shots deflecting off the laces. It's the signature touch that defines the Predator line. Should I get the League tier or the Elite for my kid? For most growing players, League is the smart call. It carries the real Predator control feel and the fold-over tongue at a price that makes sense when feet are still changing size. The Elite tier adds a higher-grade upper and a lighter, stiffer plate aimed at top-level players who play year-round; it's more cleat than most juniors need. How should I size this adidas predator youth cleat for a kid who's still growing? Order their current size and leave roughly a thumb's width at the toe for a little growing room. Resist sizing up more than that. A cleat that's too big slides on the foot and kills the control the Predator is built for, which defeats the point. Are these good for a player who likes to attack and shoot? Yes, that's exactly who they're made for. As an adidas predator youth cleat, it's built around the line's control-and-striking identity, and the haptic overlay plus the clean fold-over tongue surface give a young striker steadier contact when they line up a shot near goal. Will they hold up to a full season of play? The Nanostrike synthetic upper and Strikeframe plate are built for regular use on firm ground. Air-dry them after matches and brush off the dirt, and they'll carry a busy young player through a full season of training and games.

items.description_en: Predator built for the young player who loves to strike Some kids chase the game with their legs. Others control it with their feet, the ones who'd rather thread a perfect pass or bend a shot into the side netting. If that's your player, the adidas Junior Predator Elite was made for them: the top junior tier of the Predator line, the control-and-strike identity the pros wear, in the Road To Glory Pack colorway. The feature Predator fans spot on sight is the fold-over tongue. It covers the laces and leaves a clean strip of upper where the foot meets the ball. Most adidas predator youth cleats leave the laces exposed, so that smooth striking surface is what sets the Elite apart for the passes and shots your kid is already trying to pull off. adidas junior Predator elite construction The Nanostrike Pro mesh upper wraps the foot and carries tactile-feedback zones across the strike area, so a young player feels the ball through the cleat instead of guessing at it. For a kid still building touch, that matters. Powerspine keeps the midfoot steady when play turns quick, and the Strikeframe plate handles traction on natural grass. You'll find every adidas predator youth model on the adidas Predator collection , and the full pack on the Road To Glory Pack collection. Who these cleats are for The Junior Predator Elite is a real investment cleat, the right call for a committed young player who plays often and cares how the ball comes off their foot. If your kid asks for the Predator by name and wants the look the pros wear, it earns its place in the bag. For a casual player still deciding whether they love the sport, a more affordable adidas predator youth tier is the smarter buy. Product Details Tier: Elite, top junior Predator tier Surface: firm ground (FG), natural grass Upper: Nanostrike Pro mesh with tactile-feedback zones Striking feature: fold-over tongue for a smooth strike surface Stability: Powerspine midfoot technology Plate: Strikeframe full-length firm-ground outsole Weight: 5.8 oz (164 g), per UK 8.5 Colorway: Solar Turbo / Thermal Chrome / Core Black (Road To Glory Pack) Sizing: youth 1 to 6 Fit Notes Regular fit, true to size for most young players. Cleats fit closer than everyday shoes, so a snug feel out of the box is right. For a growing kid, leave a thumb's width at the toe: growth room without the foot sliding. Between sizes or wider feet, go up the half. Care and Maintenance Air-dry after every match; stuff with newspaper to hold shape and pull moisture Keep them off radiators and out of the dryer and direct sun, which warps the plate Brush off dried grass and dirt before they go back in the bag The Nanostrike Pro mesh needs only a soft brush and a damp-cloth wipe, no conditioner FAQs about the Junior Predator Elite What does the fold-over tongue actually do? It folds across the top of the foot and covers the laces, leaving a smooth strip of upper where the foot strikes the ball. That means cleaner contact on passes and shots, with no lace bumps in the way. It's a signature Predator feature, and on this junior Elite build it gives a young striker a consistent surface to strike from. Is an Elite junior cleat worth it for a kid? For the right kid, yes. The Elite is the top junior tier, built for a committed young player who plays regularly and cares about touch and control. If your player is serious about the game and asks for the Predator by name, the build quality and the fold-over striking surface earn their keep. For a casual or first-time player, a League or Club tier is the better value. How should I size these for a growing kid? Go true to size and leave roughly a thumb's width at the toe. That gives a little growth room without letting the foot slide, which is what causes blisters and lost control. If your player is right between two sizes, size up the half. The youth range here runs 1 to 6. What surface are these built for? Firm ground (FG). The Strikeframe plate is made for natural grass and dry, well-kept pitches, which covers most youth match days. They're not the right pick for hard, dedicated artificial turf or indoor courts; those surfaces need an AG or turf shoe. How do I keep them lasting through the season? Air-dry them after every match and keep them away from direct heat. Brush off the dried mud before storing, and give the mesh upper a quick wipe with a damp cloth. Skip the dryer and the radiator entirely; heat is what kills a cleat fastest.

items.description_en: The Collar They Wanted, the Coverage You Wanted Most cleats stop at the ankle. The adidas Junior F50 League Mid keeps going. Its mid-cut collar rises just above the ankle bone and closes in snug, so your kid gets the high-collar look the pros wear and you get more coverage around the part of the foot that twists and turns the most. As an adidas f50 youth build, it puts that pro silhouette on a kid's foot without the senior-tier price. What the Mid-Cut Collar Actually Does Picture the snug top of a winter sock. The collar works the same way: it holds the cleat tighter to the ankle so the foot moves with the shoe instead of sliding around inside it. For a young player still learning to cut and pivot, that held-in feeling builds the confidence to push off harder. The full adidas F50 collection lays out every tier side by side. Who These Are For The kid who wants to look like the players they cheer for, and the newer player whose parent likes more around the ankle. The firm-ground sole bites into dry natural grass for stop-start traction, so it's a grass build. This adidas f50 youth cleat comes in the loud Solar Turbo of the adidas Road to Glory Pack , a standout in the adidas youth soccer cleats range. If your player lives on turf or indoor courts, this one isn't it. adidas Junior F50 League Soccer Cleat Product Details Tier: League (entry-level F50 speed build) Surface: Firm Ground (FG), for dry natural grass Outsole: synthetic firm-ground outsole Upper: mid-cut synthetic Haloskin, with the collar as the headline feature Closure: laces Weight: 5.0 oz (141 g) in a youth UK 3 Colorway: Solar Turbo / Core Black / Gold Metallic (Road to Glory Pack) Sizing: youth, 1.5 and up Fit Notes Like most adidas f50 youth builds, these run true to size. Between sizes or mid-growth-spurt, go up a half size, not a full one: the collar already holds the ankle snug, so you don't want a roomy toe box. Care and Maintenance Air-dry after every match, stuffed with newspaper to pull moisture and hold the shape Keep them away from radiators, dryers, and direct sun, which crack the synthetic upper Brush off dried grass and dirt before they go back in the bag; the Haloskin upper needs only a soft brush and a damp-cloth wipe, no conditioner Knock dirt out of the collar fabric so it stays soft against the ankle FAQs about the Junior F50 League Mid What does the mid-cut collar do? The collar rises just above the ankle bone and closes snug around it, so the cleat moves with the foot instead of letting it slide around inside the shoe. Most kids describe it as feeling held rather than loose, which helps when they're planting and turning at speed. Does the collar actually support the ankle? It adds coverage and a snug, held-in fit around the ankle, and many parents like that for a younger player still learning to cut and pivot. It's a fit-and-feel benefit, not a medical brace, so it's not a substitute for a prescribed ankle support if your kid has had an injury. For everyday youth play, the snug collar gives a reassuring lockdown. How do I size a cleat with a collar? Size the same way you would any cleat, by the foot, not the collar. These run true to size. If your player is between sizes, go up a half size, not a full one; the collar already keeps the ankle snug, so you don't want extra room in the toe. Are these good for turf or indoor? No. This is a firm-ground build with studs made for dry natural grass. On turf or an indoor court the studs won't grip right and they'll wear faster. The adidas F50 collection carries turf and indoor versions for those surfaces. Will these hold up for a full season? They're the League tier, built to take a youth season of grass play. Air-dry them after matches and brush off the dirt, and the synthetic upper and collar stay in good shape. Care matters more than tier for how long a kid's cleats last.

items.description_en: A Real F50, Priced for a First Pair Most kids don't get to pick the field. They play where there's space, grass one weekend and a synthetic pitch the next, and the Junior F50 Hyperfast Club goes everywhere with them. It carries the F50 name adidas has put on its fastest cleats since 2004, scaled for a player just getting serious. The Road to Glory Pack colorway is easy to spot from the sideline. Built to Grip Two Surfaces The FG/MG outsole is what makes this an everywhere cleat. Firm ground handles dry natural grass; multi-ground handles the artificial and harder pitches kids end up on all the time. One pair, both surfaces, no second cleat to buy. The synthetic upper's debossed texture gives this adidas f50 youth cleat the touch to keep the ball where they put it. The full adidas F50 lineup runs from this Club tier up to the Elite as they grow. Who These Are For This is the value pick in the F50 range, and that's exactly who should lace them up: the beginner in their first organized season, the everyday player training twice a week, the kid who's hard on cleats and shouldn't be in a $200 pair at a muddy practice. They ship in the Road to Glory Pack that runs across the whole adidas f50 youth range, so siblings can match without trying. adidas Junior f50 Club Product Details Tier: Club (entry-level F50) Surface: firm ground and multi-ground (natural grass and artificial) Outsole: synthetic FG/MG tooling Upper: synthetic, debossed texture Closure: lace-up, floating tongue Sockliner: textile Fit: regular Weight: 6.2 oz (176 g) Colorway: Solar Turbo / Core Black / Gold Metallic Sizing: youth, 1.5 and up Fit Notes The Junior F50 Club runs in a regular fit and plays true to size for most kids. Aim for snug-but-not-tight: a thumb's width at the toe leaves room to grow without sliding. The lace closure helps you dial it in mid growth-spurt. Care and Maintenance Air-dry after play; stuff with newspaper to pull moisture and hold the shape Keep them off radiators, dryers, and direct sun, which warp the plate and dry the upper Brush off dried grass and dirt before they go back in the bag Synthetic upper, so no conditioner needed; a damp wipe handles most of it Store dry, not crammed wet in the bottom of a sports bag FAQs about the Junior F50 Club What does FG/MG mean, and is that good for a kid who plays everywhere? FG is firm ground, built for dry natural grass. MG is multi-ground, built for artificial and harder pitches. The FG/MG outsole does both, so it's a strong pick for a young player whose week bounces between a grass field and a turf one. They won't need a separate pair for each surface. Is the Club tier enough cleat for a beginner? For a beginner or an everyday youth player, yes. The Club is the entry tier in the F50 range: a light, simple, durable build at a first-pair price. Players chasing top-level competition eventually move up to the Pro or Elite tiers, but as an adidas f50 youth cleat, the Club is the right amount for a kid still learning the game. How should I size these as my kid grows? Aim for snug but not tight, with about a thumb's width of room at the toe. That leaves space to grow into without the foot sliding. The lace closure helps you fine-tune the fit between sizes, which is handy mid-season when feet change faster than the calendar. Will these hold up at this price? They will for normal youth-season use. The synthetic upper and outsole take practices and weekend games in stride. Air-dry them after play and brush off the dirt, and they'll last the season, without spending elite money on a cleat your kid may outgrow by spring. Do they fit wide feet? The Junior F50 Club runs in a regular fit, which suits most young players. For a noticeably wide foot the lace closure gives some adjustability, but a regular-width cleat is a regular-width cleat. If width has been a recurring problem, it's worth trying a pair on before you commit.

items.name: adidas Junior Copa Pure IV League Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Road To Glory Pack (SP26)
items.description: La Copa Pure IV League de adidas adidas construye sus cleats en tres carriles: velocidad en el F50, control en el Predator y toque en la Copa. La Copa Pure IV League se sienta en ese último carril, el confort primero para los jugadores que quieren una sensación limpia y natural en la pelota. Esta cuarta generación Copa Pure se remonta a un aspecto clásico con una lengua flotante que se sienta baja y fuera del camino, además de la adiPure pinline que corre tacón a dedo. Es la misma Copa se siente usada a través de la línea por jugadores como Bernardo Silva y Sam Coffey, tallado para pies más jóvenes. Vea el resto de la línea adidas Copa . Firme tierra, y donde estos largos La suela está construida para terreno firme, lo que significa césped seco y natural: la superficie más sábado liga y los partidos escolares se ejecutan. No es el zapato para césped (mira para TF), para césped artificial (AG), o para la corte interior (IC). Los clavos cortados para la hierba se desgastan rápido en el césped duro, así que emparejar la superficie es la victoria fácil que la mayoría de los padres pierden cuando compran los zapatos de fútbol infantil. Más opciones se sientan en clarisas de tierra firme juvenil para una superficie diferente. La Liga Tier, y quién es para adidas apila sus cleats Elite, Pro, League, luego Club. La liga es el nivel de valor: la mayoría de la sensación de la puntilla que los pros llevan, a un precio que se ajusta a un pie todavía creciente. Es una elección fuerte para el jugador de desarrollo o recreo todavía trabajando en su tacto, y uno de los más cómodos niños de fútbol en su gama. El camino a la gloria es parte de la caída de la Copa Mundial de adidas, así que tu jugador
items.description_en: The Copa Pure IV League by adidas adidas builds its cleats in three lanes: speed in the F50, control in the Predator, and touch in the Copa. The Copa Pure IV League sits in that last lane, the comfort-first one for players who want a clean, natural feel on the ball. This fourth-generation Copa Pure goes back to a classic look with a floating tongue that sits low and out of the way, plus the adiPure pinline running heel to toe. It's the same Copa feel worn across the line by players like Bernardo Silva and Sam Coffey, sized down for younger feet. See the rest of the adidas Copa lineup . Firm Ground, and Where These Belong The outsole is built for firm ground, which means dry, natural grass: the surface most Saturday league and school matches run on. It's not the shoe for turf (look for TF), for artificial grass (AG), or for the indoor court (IC). Studs cut for grass wear down fast on hard turf, so matching the surface is the easy win most parents miss when they shop kids' soccer cleats. More options sit in youth firm-ground cleats for a different surface. The League Tier, and Who It's For adidas stacks its cleats Elite, Pro, League, then Club. League is the value tier: most of the feel of the cleat the pros wear, at a price that fits a still-growing foot. It's a strong pick for the developing or rec player still working on their touch, and one of the more comfortable kids' soccer cleats in its range. The Road To Glory colorway is part of adidas's World Cup drop, so your player gets the look of the summer without the Elite-tier price. Fit and Sizing for Growing Feet The Copa Pure IV League runs true to size for most players and breaks in fast, usually inside a session or two. The synthetic upper gives a little without going sloppy. As with most kids' cleats, if your child has a wide foot or you want to leave growing room, go up a half size rather than a full one. These come in youth sizes 1 through 6. Product Details Fusionfeel synthetic upper, leather-like softness for a close touch on the ball Floating tongue with a lace closure for an easy step-in and an adjustable fit Cushioned textile sockliner for all-match comfort COMFORT PLATE TPU outsole, built for firm ground Regular fit Weight: 193 g (6.8 oz) Colorway: Solar Turbo / Ivory / Core Black Youth sizes 1 to 6 FAQs About The Junior Copa Pure IV League Is the Copa Pure IV League made of leather? Not on the League tier. It uses adidas Fusionfeel, a synthetic built to feel leather-soft on the ball without the break-in or upkeep of real leather. The calfskin leather shows up on the Elite and Pro Copa Pure IV. Can my kid wear these on turf or indoor courts? These are firm-ground (FG) cleats, made for dry natural grass. For turf, look for the TF version; for artificial grass, the AG; for an indoor court, an IC shoe. FG studs on hard turf wear down fast. What's the difference between the League and the Elite or Pro Copa Pure IV? Same Copa shape and look, different materials and price. Elite and Pro use calfskin leather and lighter plates for high-level play. League gives a young or rec player most of that feel and comfort at a friendlier price. Copa or F50 for a young player? Pick the Copa if your player likes to slow the game down, keep the ball, and value comfort and touch. Pick the F50 if they're the quickest one on the field and live on the shoulder of the last defender. The Copa is adidas's comfort-and-touch cleat.

items.name: adidas F50 Hyperfast Pro Indoor Soccer Shoes - Road To Glory Pack (SP26)
items.description: Speed, Shrunk Down to the Size of an Indoor Field The F50 has always been adidas' speed shoes, and the Hyperfast Pro brings that idea indoors. Al aire libre, la velocidad F50 es el largo recorrido detrás. Indoors, es pura reacción. La corte es pequeña, la pelota se mueve rápido, y quien consigue un pie allí primero gana el rep. Este zapato mantiene la luz del F50, se siente en una suela plana hecha para pisos de madera y futsal. Lo que "Pro" realmente te consigue aquí es la parte que vale la pena saber. El Pro comparte su Haloskin+ superior con la élite priciera, por lo que el toque en la bola siente lo mismo. Lo que cambia es la plataforma debajo: una construcción más convencional y una suela interior sin marcar. Sentirse de más alto nivel en un zapato de la corte que no apagará el suelo. Para la mayoría de los jugadores de interior, es la camioneta inteligente en toda la línea adidas F50. Hecho para el Jugador Futsal en Tight Space Picture un jugador squash en la parte delantera de una pequeña corte: rodillas cargadas, peso en las bolas de los pies, listo para brotar el instante que la bola sale de la pared. Ese es el juego interior, y para eso es el zapato. El dar-y-ir en una cabina telefónica del espacio, el apagar un pie cuando no hay espacio para dos. La suela plana permanece plantada para que te despegues limpio, y la espuma Lightstrike mantiene tus pies de siempre sintiendo un paso atrás. items.description_en: Speed, Shrunk Down to the Size of an Indoor Field The F50 has always been adidas' speed shoe, and the Hyperfast Pro brings that idea indoors. What changes is the platform underneath: a more conventional build and an indoor non-marking outsole. Top-tier feel on a court shoe that won't scuff the floor. For most indoor players, it's the smart pickup in the whole adidas F50 lineup . Made for the Futsal Player in Tight Space Picture a squash player at the front of a tiny court: knees loaded, weight on the balls of the feet, ready to spring the instant the ball comes off the wall. That's the indoor game, and that's who this shoe is for. The give-and-go in a phone booth of space, the turn off one foot when there's no room for two. items.description_en: The Cleat for the Player Who Logs The Miles You're not chasing a viral clip. You're chasing promotion, a cup run, a spot you earned and want to keep. The adidas F50 Pro is built for you, the player whose game runs on pace and who shows up every week to prove it on grass. The Pro tier carries that same DNA, the lightweight chassis and the run-first geometry, with materials chosen to last the season instead of shaving every last gram. For most players, yes. The Pro keeps the F50 speed build, the lightweight chassis, the firm-ground plate, and the close-fitting Haloskin+ upper, and trims cost with slightly less premium materials than the Elite. If you're playing every week and want top-end pace without the top-end price, the Pro is the smart pick. The Elite is for players chasing every last gram. Does the F50 Hyperfast Pro run true to size? It runs true to size for most players. The upper fits close and snug right out of the box, so a narrow foot or a player who likes a tight feel can stay at the standard size. Go with the F50 if speed is your game: wingers, fast strikers, and full-backs who beat defenders with acceleration. The Predator leans toward control, power, and spin, and the Copa toward a soft, natural touch. The F50 is the speed silo. items.description_en: First touch is where games turn You don't always get a second touch. The ball comes in fast, a defender's already closing, and what you do in that first half-second decides whether you keep the move alive or hand it back. The adidas Copa Pure IV Pro FG is built for that moment. It's the touch cleat in adidas' lineup, the one that puts a soft, calfskin-feel surface between your foot and the ball so a hard pass dies right where you want it. It's part of the adidas Copa Pure Road to Glory pack, dressed in Solar Turbo, but the reason serious players keep coming back to the Copa hasn't changed. It makes your best touch repeatable. On a crowded pitch, that's the gap between holding the ball up and coughing it up. Where the soft touch comes from The feel starts with Fusionskin, a calfskin-soft forefoot stitched to a synthetic mesh midfoot. You get the broken-in, close-to-the-ball touch the Copa is known for, with mesh through the middle holding your foot locked in. The classic adiPure pinline runs heel to toe, the detail Copa fans clock on sight, and a Primeknit tongue pulls everything snug for an adjustable, dialed-in fit. Underfoot, an anatomical sockliner cuts plantar pressure so the comfort holds deep into the second half. This is the Copa Pure IV Pro, and most of what makes the Elite special lives right here, just without the flagship spend you'd put down for the top tier. Who reaches for the Pro The Copa Pure IV Pro FG is for the player whose game runs through their feet. The midfielder linking play, the forward receiving with their back to goal, anyone who'd rather kill the ball clean than chase it down. The Copa Pure IV Pro is the smart call when you want that Copa touch for full-season, week-in, week-out use instead of the lightest-possible spec. Coaches, point your touch-first players here when they want the real Copa feel without the top-tier outlay. It's the cleat a touch player keeps in the bag all season and never second-guesses. Built for firm ground and dry natural grass, the league pitch you actually play on every Saturday. Product Details: Copa Pure IV Pro Fusionskin upper: a calfskin-soft forefoot stitched to a synthetic mesh midfoot for a soft, close touch on the ball. Classic adiPure pinline running heel to toe, the signature Copa detail. Primeknit tongue construction for lockdown and an adjustable, dynamic fit. Laced closure in a regular fit. Anatomical synthetic sockliner that reduces plantar pressure for all-match comfort. Comfort Frame firm-ground outsole tuned for traction on dry natural grass. Colorway: Solar Turbo / Ivory / Core Black (Road to Glory pack, SP26). Fit Notes Regular fit, true to size for most players. The Fusionskin forefoot softens and gives slightly as it breaks in, so expect a closer hug after the first few wears. Between sizes or wider feet: go up a half size and let the upper mold to your foot. Sized in adult men's and women's, M 7 / W 8 through M 11 / W 12. Care and Maintenance Wipe the Fusionskin upper down with a damp cloth after matches, then let them air-dry away from radiators and direct sun. The calfskin-soft forefoot doesn't like being baked. Skip the washing machine. It dries out the calfskin-soft feel that makes the Copa worth buying. Stuff them with newspaper between matches to hold their shape and pull moisture. Knock dried mud off the firm-ground outsole so the studs keep their bite. Work a light leather conditioner into the calfskin forefoot every few weeks to keep the touch supple through the season. FAQs about the Copa Pure IV Pro How is the Copa Pure IV Pro different from the Elite? The Pro gives you most of what the Copa Pure IV Elite does, the same Fusionskin calfskin-soft forefoot and that clean Copa touch, in a build meant for full-season, week-in, week-out play rather than the lightest-possible flagship spec. If you want the real Copa feel without the top-tier spend, the Pro is the one. (Some shoppers search it as the Copa Pure 4 Pro, it's the same cleat.) What surface are the Copa Pure IV Pro FG made for? Firm ground, which means dry natural grass, the standard league and practice pitch. The FG outsole bites into solid grass for a clean push-off. If you play mostly on artificial turf, grab the Copa Pure IV Pro Turf version instead, and skip FG on soft, muddy ground where longer studs do the job better. Do the Copa Pure IV Pro run true to size? For most players, yes, true to size in a regular fit. The Fusionskin forefoot softens and gives a little as you break it in, so they hug closer over the first few wears. If you're between sizes or have a wider foot, go up a half size and let the upper mold to you. Is the Copa Pure IV Pro a good cleat for touch-first players? That's exactly who it's built for. If your game is about controlling the ball, linking passes, and receiving cleanly under pressure, the calfskin-soft Fusionskin upper gives you the contact and feel to do it. The Copa has always been the touch player's cleat, and the Pro carries that for players who don't want to spend flagship money to get it.

items.description_en: The first touch that buys you a half-second Some players win games with pace. You win them in the half-second after the ball arrives, before the defender reads where it's going. The adidas Copa Pure IV Elite is built for that touch. The Fusionskin upper puts soft calfskin leather across the forefoot, blended into a lighter synthetic mesh midfoot, so the ball settles under your foot like it was waiting for you. This is the senior, top-tier model in the line. adidas went back to the classic look The fourth-generation Copa Pure drops the knit collar and returns to the look that made the line: a low floating tongue, a classic lace closure, and the adiPure pinline running heel to toe. It reads clean, almost old-school. To see where it sits in the rest of the touch line, browse the full Copa lineup . Built for the player who runs the tempo This is a number 8 or a number 10's cleat, for the playmaker who wants the ball to die under their foot and pop back up exactly where they meant it. The Comfort Frame outsole lets you plant, turn, and spin out of pressure without the plate fighting you. It's at its best on natural grass and well-kept pitches. Lace up the Solar Turbo colorway from the adidas Copa Pure Road to Glory pack and you look the part before you've touched the ball. If you're weighing surfaces, compare it against our firm-ground cleats . Product Details: Copa Pure IV Elite Fusionskin upper: soft calfskin forefoot stitched to a synthetic mesh midfoot adiPure pinline heel to toe for the classic Copa finish Lace closure with a low floating tongue (gen IV return to the U-throat) OrthoLite sockliner for step-in comfort Comfort Frame outsole with a soft Pebax frame and conical studs Colorway: Solar Turbo / Ivory / Core Black (Road to Glory pack) Fit Notes The Copa Pure IV Elite runs true to size. The calfskin softens and molds over the first few sessions, so a snug fit out of the box is normal. Got a wider forefoot? Calfskin gives more than synthetic, so stick with your normal size. Care and Maintenance Air-dry after every match and stuff them with paper to hold their shape Keep them away from direct heat and sunlight; dryers warp the Comfort Frame and dry out the calfskin Brush off grass and dirt before storing, and work a little leather conditioner into the calfskin forefoot every few weeks in season FAQs about the Copa Pure IV Elite Does the Copa Pure IV Elite run true to size? Yes for most players. The calfskin forefoot feels snug at first and then molds to your foot over a few sessions. If you have wide feet, the calfskin stretches more than a synthetic upper, so there's no need to size up. Is this the laced or the laceless version? This is the laced version, with a low floating tongue and a classic lace closure for a locked-in, adjustable fit. adidas also makes a laceless Copa Pure IV Elite FG if you want a fully clean strike surface; this page is the laced model. What surface are these cleats built for? Firm ground. The conical studs on the Comfort Frame outsole are made for natural grass and well-kept pitches. For artificial turf or hard, dry fields, a turf or AG version is the safer call. How is the Copa different from the Predator or F50? The Copa is the touch cleat. Where the Predator leans into control and strike and the F50 chases speed, the Copa is built around ball feel and comfort, with that calfskin forefoot doing the work on your first touch.

items.description_en: The home kit your kid already knows by heart Kids pick a favorite shirt fast, and for a young Croatia fan it's this one. The Nike 2026 Croatia Youth Stadium Home Soccer Jersey puts them in the red-and-white checkerboard, the look people picture the second someone says Croatia. They'll pull it on for the watch party, wear it to the park, and reach for it again the next morning. For a kid who's already claimed Croatia as their team, this is the shirt that makes it official. The checkerboard, the sahovnica, comes from Croatia's national coat of arms, a symbol the country has carried for centuries, and it's been the heart of the national team's home shirt for as long as fans can remember. On the 2026 home kit the checks sit on a clean white base, sharp and bright, the way the home jersey is meant to look. When your kid wears it, they're in the one piece of Croatia every supporter recognizes on sight. What the Stadium home jersey gives a young player The Croatia youth home jersey for 2026 is the Stadium version, which means replica detailing modeled on what the players wear, at a price that makes sense for a growing kid. The fabric is Nike Dri-FIT, so when they're running around in July heat it pulls the sweat off their skin instead of leaving them overheated and sticky. The 100% polyester build holds up to repeat washes and keeps the checkerboard sharp through a season of wear. If your young fan wants the look without the match-grade price, the Stadium home kit is the one to grab, and you'll find the rest of the lineup on the Croatia collection . Check the size chart on this page for the measurements on each youth size, and if your kid is between sizes, going up buys a little growing room. Is this the Stadium or the Authentic Croatia jersey? items.description: adidas y la UAEFA adidas suministran la Asociación de Fútbol de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos en todo el ciclo actual. Estadio Edición vs Authentic Cut Esta es la edición del Estadio, lo que la mayoría de los partidarios llevan en el stand y en la calle. El tejido es un poliéster doblecnit (100% reciclado) con paneles de tejido adidas Climacool que mueven el sudor del cuerpo. El ajuste corre delgado por el pecho y el hombro, con un collar que se sienta limpio bajo la placa. La edición Authentic (se vende por separado cuando se almacena) endurece el corte y cambia el panel construir para un tejido gestionado por calor con insignias en lugar de los bordados. Elige el Estadio si quieres la mirada, la placa de federación y la mano doble. Escoge el Authentic si quieres que el corte Al-Abyad se encienda para los partidos. El estadio Fit y Sizing corre delgado por el pecho. Si usas una camiseta en el pecho que metes hoy, ese es tu tamaño. Si usas una tee de corte relajado, tamaño uno. El tejido se extiende por el hombro; se mantiene apretado en la cera
items.description_en: adidas and the UAEFA adidas supplies the United Arab Emirates Football Association across the current cycle. This is the 2026 UAE soccer jersey, the start of the 2026 to 2028 home run, and the design pulls directly from the federation's visual identity: white as the dominant base, red across the V neck and the shoulder stripes, and a sleeve pattern lifted from the UAEFA's Arabic-script logomark. The four colors that run through the kit (red, white, black, green) track the UAE flag. The embroidered federation crest sits centered on the chest in the traditional placement. Stadium Edition vs the Authentic Cut This is the Stadium edition, what most supporters wear in the stand and on the street. The fabric is a doubleknit polyester (100% recycled) with adidas Climacool weave panels that move sweat off the body. The fit runs slim through the chest and shoulder, with a collar that sits clean under the badge. The Authentic edition (sold separately when stocked) tightens the cut further and swaps the panel build for a heat-managed weave with heat-bonded badges in place of the embroidered ones. Pick the Stadium if you want the look, the federation badge, and the doubleknit hand. Pick the Authentic if you want the cut Al-Abyad pulls on for matches. Fit and Sizing Stadium runs slim through the chest. If you wear a fitted t-shirt at the chest you measure today, that's your size. If you wear a relaxed-cut tee, size up one. The fabric stretches across the shoulder; it holds tight at the waist hem. The slim silhouette doubleknit construction is built to move with you on the pitch and sit clean off it. What You're Buying Into Picking up a UAE soccer jersey in 2026 says you're with Al-Abyad through a rebuilding cycle. The qualifying run ended in the AFC playoffs against Iraq, but the squad heads into the AFC Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia in January 2027 in Group E alongside South Korea and Vietnam, with Paulo Bento at the helm and Ali Mabkhout still leading the line. This is the kit they pull on for that, and the one adidas's federation kit lineup sits inside. items.name: Nike Zoom Vapor 16 Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Showtime Pack (SU26)
items.description: Nike Zoom Vapor 16 Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Showtime Pack (SU26) Detalles del producto Bienvenidos a la calma antes de la tormenta. Con materiales espejo y una paleta de colores relajante, este LV8 le da la oportunidad de respirar, reflexionar y prepararse para el escenario más grande del fútbol. Nike Gripknit es un material pegajoso que proporciona un mejor toque a la pelota. La textura micromoldeadora moldea a la forma de tu pie y da igual agarre en condiciones húmedas o secas para un ajuste esculpido y similar al pico de pista. Una unidad de zoom de aire de 3/4 longitud se construye en la placa de tracción, con un patrón de onda de stud de chevron para ayudarle a morder el suelo cuando más lo necesita. El Flyknit superior, diseñado para los jugadores más rápidos del juego, proporciona un ajuste similar al tacto. Combina con Gripknit para formar el más delgado Mercurial hasta la fecha, acercándote a la pelota y acortando el tiempo de ruptura.
items.description_en: Nike Zoom Vapor 16 Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Showtime Pack (SU26) Product Details Welcome to the calm before the storm. With mirrored materials and a relaxing color pallet, this LV8 cleat is giving you the chance to breathe, reflect and prepare yourself for the biggest stage in soccer. Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. The micromolding texture molds to the shape of your foot and gives equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. A unique 3/4-length Air Zoom unit is built into the traction plate, with a chevron stud wave pattern to help you bite the ground when you need it most. The Flyknit upper, engineered for the game's fastest players, provides a sock-like fit. It combines with Gripknit to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and shortening break-in time.

items.name: Nike Tiempo Maestro Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats- Showtime Pack (SU26)
items.description: Nike Tiempo Maestro Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Showtime Pack (SU26) Product Details TECHLEATHER on the upper, located where you need it for creative dribbling, is a supersoft material. Proporciona un toque más consistente en condiciones húmedas o secas que el cuero natural. Sus líneas moldeadas mejoran la experiencia táctil. Arriba, TECHLEATHER se adapta a la forma de tu pie para un ajuste agradable. En la parte inferior, la placa dividida Maestro360, ubicada en el talón y el pie, permite que el cuero sintético de la parte superior envolver el arco de su pie para mejorar aún más la sensación de un ajuste similar al guante. Los espárragos en la suela en el talón y el pie delantero proporcionan tracción para agarrar el campo. Twisted conical studs le ayudan a plantar y pivotar con facilidad.
items.description_en: Nike Tiempo Maestro Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Showtime Pack (SU26) Product Details TECHLEATHER on the upper, located where you need it for creative dribbling, is a supersoft material. It provides a more consistent touch in wet or dry conditions than natural leather. Its molded lines enhance the touch experience. Up top, TECHLEATHER adapts to the shape of your foot for an accommodating fit. At the bottom, the Maestro360 split plate, located at the forefoot and heel, allows the synthetic leather of the upper to wrap the arch of your foot to further enhance the feeling of a glove-like fit. Bladed studs on the outsole at the heel and forefoot provide traction for gripping the field. Twisted conical studs help you plant and pivot with ease.

items.description: Nike Phantom 6 Low Academy Firm/Multi Ground Soccer Cleats - Haaland PE (SU26) Detalles del producto Esta versión te lleva con un gráfico de tacón parecido a un vórtice, hablando con el efecto magnético de Erling en el campo. Una zona de contacto expandida de NikeSkin, alimentada por malla diseñada, proporciona control de bolas mientras gotea y pasa, incluso en condiciones húmedas o secas. items.description_en: Nike Phantom 6 Low Academy Firm/Multi Ground Soccer Cleats - Haaland PE (SU26) Product Details This version pulls you in with a heel graphic resembling a vortex, speaking to Erling’s magnetic effect on the field. The vibrant, contrasting colors both nod to Erling’s fierce competitiveness and his belief that soccer should be played with joy. An expanded NikeSkin touch zone, powered by engineered mesh, provides ball control while dribbling and passing, even in wet or dry conditions. Strategically placed in the forefoot, the Cyclone 360 circular traction pattern helps you plant and pivot with speed. The shoe frame gives you a more natural fit, especially in the toe box. It helps mold to your foot and brings you closer to the ball for even better cleat-to-ball strikes.

items.name: Nike Tiempo Ligera Pro Firm Ground Soccer Cleats (SU26)
items.description: The touch that dies at your feet Dry grass, mid-July, and the pass comes in flat and fast. Most players kill it twice, and by then the defender has closed. You want it to stop where you put it. That's the Tiempo argument, and the Ligera Pro is built for players who take the ball through traffic rather than around it. Stitched leather feel without the leather problem Nike stitches Techleather onto the upper right where your foot meets the ball. It's supersoft, and it holds a more consistent touch in wet or dry conditions than natural leather does. Up top it adapts to the shape of your foot without overstretching, so the fit you break in is the fit you keep. The rest of the Nike Tiempo cleats line runs on the same idea. Firm ground, match day, ninety minutes This is a natural grass shoe. Conical studs give you enough to plant and turn without the bite that makes your knee do the work, and they hold up late in the second half. If most of your week happens on the small-sided surface, the turf version of the Ligera Pro is the pair to train in. Product Details: Tiempo Ligera Pro FG Stitched Techleather upper, placed for creative dribbling More consistent touch wet or dry than natural leather Adapts to the shape of your foot without overstretching Conical studs for traction plus comfort Firm Ground plate for natural grass Fit Notes Tiempo sits closer to comfort than to a race-tight speed last, so order your normal size. The Techleather gives a little as it molds, so between sizes, take the smaller one. Care and Maintenance Brush off dried grass and dirt before storing Air-dry at room temperature, stuffed with newspaper No dryers or radiators, heat warps the plate Wipe the Techleather with a damp cloth FAQs about the Tiempo Ligera Pro FG Does the Techleather upper need conditioner? No. Techleather is synthetic, so it won't dry out the way natural leather does. A damp cloth and air-drying covers it. Can I wear these on artificial grass? They're built for firm natural ground. If synthetic surfaces dominate your week, the turf build is the smarter buy. Do they run true to size? Yes for most players. The upper molds with wear, so between sizes, take the smaller one.

An incredibly lightweight, yet strong Flyknit on the side panels provides support and brings you closer to the ball.

items.description: Nike Zoom Superfly 10 Elite KM Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Mbappe PE (SP26) Product Details Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel.

items.name: adidas Predator Elite Fold-Over Tongue Artificial Grass Soccer Cleats - Born For Goals Pack (SP26)
items.description: The tongue folds over and the laces stop mattering You've hit the one where the laces caught it wrong. It slices, it sits up, the keeper reads it early. The fold-over tongue lays a smooth face over the top of your foot, so the shot you rehearsed all week is the one that actually comes off your foot. adidas built the grip into the strike zone Nanostrike+ is why a wet ball still bends. Mesh and rubber grip elements sit across the strike zone, so Saturday rain doesn't cost you the swerve you found on Tuesday. Powerspine gives the midfoot something to drive against, and the Primeknit upper expands with your foot instead of fighting it. The wider adidas Predator range shows where Elite sits. Made for the green plastic you actually train on Most of your week happens on 3G. School field, club training, the winter league that never touches real grass. This is the artificial grass build, and the Strikeframe plate keeps full-length traction under you when you plant and open your hips. Compare plates in the artificial grass cleats collection. Product Details: Predator Elite AG Primeknit upper, synthetic and textile construction Fold-over tongue for a smooth striking surface Nanostrike+ mesh with rubber grip elements across the strike zone Powerspine midfoot support for stronger shots Strikeframe lightweight full-length plate, artificial grass outsole Synthetic lining and synthetic outsole Born For Goals Pack, SP26 release Fit Notes The Primeknit upper wraps close and expands as your foot moves, so it reads snug out of the box and settles after a couple of sessions. Order your usual size. If you play in thicker socks or sit on the wide side, try a half size up. Care and Maintenance Brush off turf pellets and dirt after every session Air-dry at room temperature, away from heaters and direct sun Stuff with newspaper to pull moisture out and hold the shape Never machine wash or tumble dry the synthetic upper Store in a ventilated bag, not sealed in your kit bag FAQs about the Predator Elite AG Can I wear these on natural grass? You can, but the artificial grass plate is tuned for synthetic surfaces. For regular play on natural grass, a firm ground Predator is the better match. What does the fold-over tongue actually do? It covers the laces with a smooth face, which gives you a clean contact point for driven shots and bent balls instead of an uneven lace line. How is Elite different from the lower tiers? Elite carries the full package: Primeknit, Nanostrike+, Powerspine, and the Strikeframe plate. Lower tiers simplify the upper and the stability setup.

items.name: adidas F50 League Indoor Soccer Shoes - Born For Goals Pack (SP26)
items.description: Quick first step on a gym floor Indoor soccer happens in a yard of space. Your kid takes the ball with a defender already on their shoulder, and the first touch either gets them out or it doesn't. That's what these are for. adidas F50 League Indoor, from the Fiberskin up Indoors the ball comes fast and flat, with no grass to slow it. The Fiberskin upper puts 3D lines where the foot meets the ball, so a touch that would skip away stays put. The EVA midsole takes the sting out of a hard floor. The rest of the line sits in the adidas F50 range . Where these shoes actually go Indoor courts, futsal nights, the stretch of winter when practice moves inside. The non-marking rubber outsole clears the facility rule about soles, and it grips a flat floor instead of sliding out on a cut. Our indoor soccer shoes collection lays out the rest of the options. Product Details: F50 League Indoor Fiberskin upper, synthetic and textile, with 3D lines across the forefoot Non-marking rubber outsole for indoor courts and futsal Lightweight EVA midsole Textile sockliner Suede toe bumper Colorway: Born For Goals pack (SP26) Fit Notes These run true to size. Indoor shoes sit closer to the foot than an outdoor cleat, so leave a thumbnail of room at the toe and no more. Care and Maintenance Air-dry after every session and stuff them with paper No heat, no dryer, which warps the outsole Air them out at home instead of leaving them in the bag, which is most of the smell FAQs about the F50 League Indoor Can they wear these on turf? Not really. The flat rubber outsole has nothing to bite into outdoors. What size for a wide foot? Start with their normal size. The upper gives a little as it breaks in. Will these mark the gym floor? No, the outsole is non-marking rubber, which is what most facilities ask for.

items.name: Nike Zoom Superfly 10 Elite Artificial Grass Pro Soccer Cleats - Max Voltage Pack (HO25)
items.description: Nike Zoom Superfly 10 Elite Artificial Grass Pro Soccer Cleats - Max Voltage Pack (HO25) Product Details Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel.

items.name: Nike Zoom Superfly 10 PRO Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Max Voltage Pack (HO25)
items.description: Nike Zoom Superfly 10 PRO Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Max Voltage Pack (HO25) Product Details A tacky skin finish is geared for goals and maintaining control of the ball when dribbling at high speeds. The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. For the first time in Mercurial, we’ve developed a full Flyknit upper. It’s tuned for the needs of the game and sent through the Mercurial filter, so it’s engineered for speed. An incredibly lightweight, yet strong Flyknit on the side panels provides support and brings you closer to the ball. A stretchy Flyknit collar provides a secure fit.

items.description: Nike Legend 10 Academy Firm/Multi Ground Soccer Cleats - Max Voltage Pack (HO25) Product Details See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. FlyTouch Lite engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. Tongue construction with additional padding gives you a secure feel and comfort in key strike zones. Microfiber lining creates a premium feel. The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions.

The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel.

items.name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Pro Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Erling Haaland Pack (FA25)
items.description: Cool in the heel, fire at the toe Look down at the heel and it's blue. Nike calls that the calm Erling's holding as he settles himself in the heat of the moment. From there it runs forward into red and yellow, brightest where most goals get scored. You're wearing the whole sequence. VNMSkin grips, Flyknit keeps it quiet Nike VNMSkin wraps the striking area, a grippy surface that holds the ball on a first touch and holds up when you strike early. Flyknit runs underneath, so the shell sits tight. The frame is new too, molding to the shape of your foot. The full Nike Phantom cleats range shows the rest of the line. Firm ground, and the second the gap opens Cyclone 360 sits in the forefoot, a circular pattern for the moment you plant and turn. On dry grass that's a clean pivot instead of two steps spent recovering. The low cut keeps the collar out of it, so your ankle just moves. The rest of our firm ground cleats sit alongside these. It helps mold to Erling's foot and brings him closer to the ball for even better cleat-to-ball strikes.

items.name: Nike Phantom 6 High Elite Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Shadow Pack (FA25)
items.description: The ball doesn't slide off the laces Placement is a decision you make in a tenth of a second. You see the far post, you turn your hips, and the only question left is whether the cleat holds the ball long enough to send it where you looked. This one is for players who pick a corner instead of hammering it. Nike put the grip in the strike zone The Nike Phantom 6 High Elite FG puts Nike Gripknit across the strike zone, a sticky texture that grips the same wet or dry. Under it, a new frame molds to your foot. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy Flyknit, and Ghost Lacing covers your laces once you tie up. The rest of the line sits on the Nike Phantom cleats page. Firm natural grass, competitive minutes A firm ground plate means kept natural grass on a Saturday, not a worn practice field and not a turf box. The Cyclone 360 circular traction pattern sits in the forefoot, where you plant to change direction and push off again. If your week crosses more than one surface, check the wider set of firm ground cleats first. Product Details: Nike Phantom 6 High Elite FG Nike Gripknit upper, equal grip wet or dry Firm ground (FG) plate for natural grass Cyclone 360 circular traction pattern in the forefoot New shoe frame that molds to the foot Dynamic Fit collar in soft, stretchy Flyknit Ghost Lacing system that covers the laces Shadow Pack (FA25) colorway Fit Notes Runs true to size for most players. The frame molds to your foot, so a snug first wear settles in rather than stretching out. The collar is a high cut: pull it on like a sock, heel first. In thick socks, go a half size up. Care and Maintenance Brush off dried grass and dirt after each match Air-dry away from direct heat; stuff with newspaper to hold shape No dryers and no sunny dashboards, since heat warps the plate Wipe the Gripknit upper with a damp cloth; no conditioner needed Store in a ventilated bag, never sealed in plastic FAQs about the Phantom 6 High Elite FG Does the Phantom 6 High Elite FG run true to size? Yes for most players. Take your usual Nike size unless you play in thick socks. Can I wear these on artificial grass? The FG plate is built for natural grass. On artificial surfaces, an AG plate spreads pressure better and holds up longer. Does Gripknit still grip in the rain? It does. Nike built Gripknit for equal grip in wet or dry conditions.

items.name: Nike Legend 10 Pro Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Shadow Pack (FA25)
items.description: Nike Legend 10 Pro Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Shadow Pack (FA25) Product Details See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. All Conditions Control (ACC) technology adds a grippy texture in both wet and dry conditions. FlyTouch Pro engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. A knit inner sleeve gives you a secure feel. The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions.

items.name: Nike Zoom Vapor 16 Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Fear Nothing Pack (FA25)
items.description: Nike Zoom Vapor 16 Elite LV8 Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Fear Nothing Pack (FA25) STICKY TOUCH Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for an extremely sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. SNUG FIT The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. In the quarter panels, there is an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit (also known as Atomknit) that tapers weight and provides support. And through the u-throat we offer the adaptable Flyknit that our players love and trust. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, brings you closer to the ball and lessens break-in time. FAST TRACTION The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud in the series is the same height as our traditional middle studs so traction is not compromised. We’ve paired the wave traction with evolved chevron and blade studs in quick acceleration stops.

items.name: Nike Zoom Vapor 16 Elite KM Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Mbappe PE (SU25)
items.description: Nike Zoom Vapor 16 Elite KM Firm Ground Soccer Cleats - Mbappe PE (SU25) Product Details The wave-like traction pattern works with the Air Zoom unit to unlock Kylian's blazing speed. It takes up more surface area of the Air Zoom unit compared to the Vapor 15 while providing the right amount of grip. It combines with chevron and blade studs to help Kylian stop when making cuts. Nike Gripknit, a sticky material that provides exceptional touch to the ball, gives Kylian the control he needs when dribbling at high speeds. It provides equal grip in wet or dry conditions. The Flyknit upper, engineered for the game's fastest players, provides a sock-like fit. It combines with Gripknit to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing Kylian closer to the ball and shortening break-in time. Heel graphic from Kylian's 2018 "Rising Fire" cleat Swoosh logo nods to Kylian's hometown and "Bondy Dreams" 2019 PE Lightning-bolt Swoosh logo and monogram salute his "Rosa" 2020 cleat Flames graphic comes from the 2021 "Flames" PE Two stars celebrate France's victories on the big stage Sockliner features an inspirational quote from Kylian

items.name: Nike Legend 10 Academy Firm/Multi Ground Soccer Cleats - Mad Energy Pack (SP25)
items.description: Nike Legend 10 Academy Firm/Multi Ground Soccer Cleats - Mad Energy Pack (SP25) Product Details See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. FlyTouch Lite engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. Tongue construction with additional padding gives you a secure feel and comfort in key strike zones. Microfiber lining creates a premium feel. The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions.

items.name: Nike Legend 10 Academy Indoor - Mad Energy Pack (SP25)
items.description: Nike Legend 10 Academy Indoor - Mad Energy Pack (SP25) Product Details See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the court. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the shoe. FlyTouch Lite engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the shoe mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. Mesh tongue with additional padding gives you a secure feel and comfort in key strike zones. Microfiber lining creates a premium feel. Rubber outsole gives you traction for street, court and indoor surfaces.

items.name: Nike Phantom Luna II Elite FG - Mad Voltage Pack (HO24)
items.description: Nike Phantom Luna II Elite FG - Mad Voltage Pack (HO24) Obsessed with perfecting your craft? We made this for you. In the middle of the storm, with chaos swirling all around you, you’ve calmly found the final third of the field, thanks to your uncanny mix of on-ball guile and grace. Go finish the job in the Phantom Luna 2 Elite. Revolutionary Nike Gripknit covers the striking area of the cleat while Nike Cyclone 360 traction helps guide your unscripted agility. We design Elite cleats for you and the world’s biggest stars to give you high-level quality, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Product Details Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides exceptional touch to the ball. It covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you great grip in wet or dry conditions. Micro-molding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quicker (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Asymmetric lacing offers a large touch surface when dribbling, passing and scoring. A repositioned lacing pattern allows for increased midfoot adjustability to accommodate players with flatter or higher arches. Asymmetrical Flyknit cuff material provides snugness and shape around your ankle. Subtle ribs in the cuff allow for ball contact higher up the ankle in trapping and passing.

Its synthetic construction provides a comfortable, flexible fit that allows you to move lightly on the court. The textured upper allows you to have control over the ball on any surface, it gives you the confidence to take accurate shots and effective dribbles with every touch. Its EVA Core insole offers the lightness and comfort you need with every step, reducing pressure on the sole of the foot when walking the court. The heel counter provides additional stability that allows you to make quick movements and changes of direction with agility. Its TPU outsole gives you support and flexibility in the areas needed for the best traction and speed in every match.

items.description: adidas Predator Elite FG - Vivid Horizon Pack (FA24) When the goal's in your sights, adidas Predator converts pressure into pinpoint accuracy. items.name: Nike Phantom Luna II Academy FG/MG - Shadow Pack (FA24)
items.description: Nike Phantom Luna II Academy FG/MG - Shadow Pack (FA24) Looking to take your game to the next level? The Phantom Luna 2 Academy helps put you in prime position of the net, whether you're the organizer, assister or finisher. The rest is up to you. Created with goals in mind, NikeSkin covers the striking area of the cleat while Nike Cyclone 360 traction helps guide your unscripted agility. Product Details We expanded the NikeSkin touch zone from the previous version. This brings your foot even closer to the ball for better control while dribbling and passing in wet or dry conditions. It covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quick (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. The anatomical mesh cuff offers soft comfort around your ankle and heel. Subtle ribs in the cuff allow for ball contact higher up the ankle in trapping and passing.

items.name: Macron 2024-25 Stoke City Authentic Home Jersey
items.description: Macron 2024-25 Stoke City Authentic Home Jersey A classic design that honors the rich traditions of the club. The Stoke City FC home jersey for the 2024/25 season features iconic red and white vertical stripes in a sublimated print. The collar is crew neck and the back neck is customized. The use of eco-friendly materials ensures maximum breathability and comfort, keeping the body cool and dry during every game. This choice underlines the club's commitment to sustainability and environmental respect. A symbol of unity and strength, it is the garment to wear proudly to support your favorite team. OFFICIAL LICENSED PRODUCT | This official, certified product has been designed and made by Macron for and in close conjunction with the Club. It conforms to the strictest standards of authenticity and traceability in the supply chain. Silicone club badge Piping Dye-sub print Macron Hero silicone badge Material Eco Softlock: Technical fabric specially designed for game sets with 100% recycled polyester yarn. It is light, soft and very resistant to tearing. Quick drying guaranteed. Macron Eco Fabrics are made with a thread which is 100% PET recycled polyester and is certified Global Recycle Standard. PET is a material made of oil or natural gas and can be 100% recycled, thus returning in the market in the form of new eco-sustainable products. In particular, the PET gathered after its first use is reduced in 2 mm chips and subsequently treated in order to obtain a thread that guarantees the same performance of a virgin thread. The thread does not lose its original characteristics during its treatment and for this reason may be repeatedly recycled. Last but not least, compared to virgin polyester, the PET recycled polyester has the advantage of requiring less energy during the production chain. For each produced shirt, 13 0.5 l bottles are recycled.

items.name: Charly 2024-25 Santos Men's Stadium Home Jersey
items.description: Charly 2024-25 Santos Men's Stadium Home Jersey We proudly present the new Santos Home Jersey for Men 24-25, a piece that encapsulates the deep passion and proud legacy of Club Santos Laguna. This jersey is unique in its design with the green and white stripes representing the team vertically, a detail that was used in its 25th anniversary in 2008-2009. It has a Performance cut with a round neck and classic style sleeves, providing greater fit and mobility. With green and white elastic details. It incorporates unique details: the emblematic "S" of the club's shield in a subtle way in all green stripes and the traditional shield of the team in silicone material, which makes it more durable and provides a 3D effect, giving a touch that symbolizes the loyalty we carry to the team in our skin. Made of 100% polyester soft-touch, its special breathable mesh fabric "MESH" along with its quick-drying DRY FACTOR technology will keep you dry for longer, ensuring extra freshness before, during and after each activity or training thanks to its specialized moisture transfer fabrics. In addition, its NANO GUARD technology provides a high level of comfort allowing your skin to breathe and avoiding unexpected odors. Additionally, its UV BLOCK technology is specially designed to protect you from ultraviolet rays, giving you all the care your skin requires, ensuring that you are always ready to support your favorite team from the stands or to keep cool during your matches. Show that you are part of the most passionate and loyal fans in Mexican soccer, wearing the indomitable spirit of a true Guerrero on your skin.

items.description: Joma Aguila Cup 2401 Classic design football cleats, designed to play on firm ground (FG), such as hard natural grass. The design is made of microfiber, a lightweight, resistant material with excellent abrasion resistance. In addition helping sweat absorption, so the foot will stay cool and dry even during peak performance. Completely renovated and improved design eliminating the over tongue optimizing a snug-fit and comfort. The heel incorporates an EXO COUNTER heel counter protecting and strengthening the area. With an injection-molded insole keeping the base smooth over time. High-quality PU synthetic sole with good resistance to wear-and-tear due to abrasion. New design adapted to the type of terrain to better control movements on firm, non-abrasive ground. Features longer studs structure. items.description: Nike Women's Academy 23 Drill Top Every journey to excellence begins with mastering the fundamentals. But make no mistake, the Nike Dri-FIT Academy top is an essential that hides it well. Mesh on the sleeves and sides allows air to circulate for a continuous cool feeling.

items.name: Manchester United 2024 Official Calendar
items.description: Manchester United 2024 Official Calendar Don’t miss out on the Manchester United 2024 Calendar! This Manchester United 2024 Calendar is perfect for a fan of The Reds. Founded in 1878, Manchester United has won 20 English League titles, 12 FA Cups, 4 League Cups, 3 European Champions Cups, and 1 FIFA Club World Cup. Being one of the most successful clubs in England, it is currently managed by Ole Gunnar Solskjær but has also been managed by famous and talented men such as Jose Mourinho, David Moyes, and the unforgettable Sir Alex Ferguson. Home to the club is Old Trafford, the largest club football stadium in the United Kingdom. This Manchester United Calendar can be displayed on a wall achieving an uncluttered space. This calendar can be used in the home, office, or kitchen and features a month-to-view layout and with an easy flip-top binding, making it simple to look at the coming months.

items.name: Nike Phantom 6 High Elite
items.description: Obsessed with accuracy? Us too. That’s why we designed the Phantom 6 Elite with revolutionary Gripknit to power your precision. The sticky texture brings your foot closer to the ball and helps put you in control of every opportunity—because missing isn’t an option. It gives you an unfair scoring advantage by combining with the Cyclone 360 traction plate for all those quick cuts. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit, a sticky texture that provides grip where you need it, gives you the control you need for ultimate precision. It provides equal grip in wet or dry conditions. Traction for the Field Strategically placed in the forefoot, the Cyclone 360 circular traction pattern helps you plant and pivot with speed. Natural Fit A new shoe frame gives you a more natural fit, especially in the toe box. It helps mold to your foot and brings you closer to the ball for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy Flyknit material for a secure feel. Ghost Lacing system covers your laces once you tie up to help limit distractions. More Details For use on dry, natural-grass fields Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Phantom Luna 2 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your game to the next level? The Phantom Luna 2 Academy helps put you in prime position of the net, whether you're the organizer, assister or finisher. The rest is up to you. Created with goals in mind, NikeSkin covers the striking area of the cleat while Nike Cyclone 360 traction helps guide your unscripted agility. Amplified Touch We expanded the NikeSkin touch zone from the previous version. This brings your foot even closer to the ball for better control while dribbling and passing in wet or dry conditions. It covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. Quick Traction Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quick (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Fit for the Field The anatomical mesh cuff offers soft comfort around your ankle and heel. Subtle ribs in the cuff allow for ball contact higher up the ankle in trapping and passing. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole
