items.name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite LV8
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made the Vapor 16 Elite with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. This version's soothing details help clear your mind before the year's biggest moment. Welcome to the calm before the storm. With mirrored materials and a relaxing color pallet, this LV8 cleat is giving you the chance to breathe, reflect and prepare yourself for the biggest stage in soccer. Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. The micromolding texture molds to the shape of your foot and gives equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. A unique 3/4-length Air Zoom unit is built into the traction plate, with a chevron stud wave pattern to help you bite the ground when you need it most. The Flyknit upper, engineered for the game's fastest players, provides a sock-like fit. It combines with Gripknit to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and shortening break-in time. More Details For use on dry, natural-grass fields Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Phantom Luna 2 Pro
items.description: Serious about your game? We made this for you. In the middle of the storm, with chaos swirling all around you, you’ve calmly found the final third of the field, thanks to your uncanny mix of on-ball guile and grace. Go finish the job in the Phantom Luna 2 Pro. Take your skills to the next level with some of Nike’s greatest innovations, like a stretchy Flyknit upper and Nike Cyclone 360 traction to help guide your unscripted agility. Touch for All Conditions A grippy overlay covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. The material helps give you control in damp and dry weather. Quick Traction Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quicker (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Snug Fit Asymmetric lacing offers a large touch surface when dribbling, passing and scoring. A repositioned lacing pattern allows for increased midfoot adjustability to accommodate players with flatter or higher arches. Asymmetrical Flyknit cuff material provides snugness and shape around your ankle. Subtle ribs in the cuff allow for ball contact higher up the ankle in trapping and passing. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

A look that says Real Madrid through and through.

The HybridTouch upper offers a soft and pliable feel, helping facilitate precise control and comfort during play. Designed for firm ground surfaces, the Sprintplate 360 technology offers traction. The synthetic floating tongue aids breathability, helping keep feet cool during matches. With non-removable studs, these shoes offer stability and grip, making them suitable for school sports and weekend matches. Adorned with the 3-Stripes and Messi branding, these shoes offer not just performance but also style. Let your child experience the thrill of soccer with adidas. Details Regular fit Laces Synthetic and textile upper Textile sockliner Synthetic outsole Sprintplate 360 technology HybridTouch upper

items.name: Nike Jr. Mercurial Superfly 10 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your speed to the next level? We made these Academy cleats with an improved heel Air Zoom unit. It gives you the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, so you can flash your speed and put the ball in the back of the net. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. Snug Fit Pull tabs and a strap combine for a design that eliminates the need for laces and helps get you on the field fast. We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous generation to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. A Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.description: Serious about your speed? Pro cleats are for those who want to push the pace all match long. That's why we made these with an improved Air Zoom unit. It gives you and those devoted to the game the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. Take your skills to the next level with some of Nike’s greatest innovations like Flyknit on the upper, which makes the shoe even lighter so you can play fast. Enhanced Touch A tacky skin finish is geared for goals and maintaining control of the ball when dribbling at high speeds. Fast Traction A new generative design outsole offers extra support in the heel and super-sticky traction when stopping and swerving. Snug Fit For the first time in Mercurial, we’ve developed a full Flyknit upper. It’s tuned for the needs of the game and sent through the Mercurial filter, so it’s engineered for speed. An incredibly lightweight, yet strong Flyknit on the side panels provides support and brings you closer to the ball. More Details For use on shorter, synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Pro
items.description: Even Legends find ways to evolve. Made for those serious about their game, the latest iteration of these Pro cleats has all-new FlyTouch Pro engineered leather. Softer than natural leather, it conforms to your foot and works with All Conditions Control (a grippy texture even in wet weather), so you can dictate the pace of your game. Lighter and sleeker than any other Tiempo to date, the Legend 10 is for any position on the field, whether you're sending a pinpoint pass through the defense or tracking back to stop a breakaway. Amplified Touch See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. All Conditions Control (ACC) technology adds a grippy texture in both wet and dry conditions. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Pro engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. A knit inner sleeve gives you a secure feel. Traction for the Field The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Tiempo Maestro Elite
items.description: Wreaking havoc on the defense requires total command of the ball. That's why we designed every aspect of the Tiempo Maestro Elite to put you in complete control of every touch. Its all-new TechLeather material, softer than natural leather, combines with a flexible Maestro360 plate to give you a glove-like fit no matter where the ball strikes. Supersoft Touch TechLeather on the upper, located where you need it for creative dribbling, is a supersoft material. It provides a more consistent touch in wet or dry conditions than natural leather. Its molded lines enhance the touch experience. Glove-Like Fit Up top, TechLeather adapts to the shape of your foot for an accommodating fit. At the bottom, the Maestro360 split plate, located at the forefoot and heel, allows the synthetic leather of the upper to wrap the arch of your foot to further enhance the feeling of a glove-like fit. Traction for the Field Bladed studs on the outsole at the heel and forefoot provide traction for gripping the field. Twisted conical studs help you plant and pivot with ease. More Details For use on dry, natural-grass fields Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite "Kylian Mbappé"
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So is Kylian Mbappe. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you, and Kylian, the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Launch: Mbappe Player Edition A legacy in motion, this striking Grand Purple drop celebrates Kylian Mbappe’s rise through five iconic silhouettes, built for pure acceleration and bold ambition. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

Take your skills to the next level with some of Nike’s greatest innovations like Flyknit on the upper, which makes the cleat even lighter so you can play fast. Sticky Touch A tacky skin finish is geared for goals and maintaining control of the ball when dribbling at high speeds. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit For the first time in Mercurial, we’ve developed a full Flyknit upper. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Academy
items.description: Even Legends find ways to evolve. Made to take your game to the next level, the latest iteration of these Academy shoes has all-new FlyTouch Lite engineered leather. Softer than natural leather, it conforms to your foot and doesn't overstretch, so you can dictate the pace of your game. Lighter and sleeker than any other Tiempo to date, the Legend 10 is for any position on the field, whether you're sending a pinpoint pass through the defense or tracking back to stop a breakaway. Amplified Touch See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the turf. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the shoe. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Lite engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the shoe mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. Tongue construction with additional padding gives you a secure feel and comfort in key strike zones. Microfiber lining creates a premium feel. Traction for the Turf Rubber outsole gives you traction on turf surfaces. More Details For use on shorter, synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Phantom Luna 2 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your game to the next level? The Phantom Luna 2 Academy helps put you in prime position of the net, whether you're the organizer, assister or finisher. The rest is up to you. Created with goals in mind, NikeSkin covers the striking area of the cleat while Nike Cyclone 360 traction helps guide your unscripted agility. Amplified Touch We expanded the NikeSkin touch zone from the previous version. This brings your foot even closer to the ball for better control while dribbling and passing in wet or dry conditions. It covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. Quick Traction Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quick (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Fit for the Field The anatomical mesh cuff offers soft comfort around your ankle and heel. Subtle ribs in the cuff allow for ball contact higher up the ankle in trapping and passing. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Phantom 6 High Pro
items.description: Turn misses into makes with the Phantom 6 Pro. It powers your precision with grippy VNMSkin and Flyknit material, which bring your foot closer to the ball for clean strikes and next-level accuracy. Touch for Clean Strikes Nike VNMSkin is a grippy material that covers the striking area of the cleat and offers great control of the ball when dribbling, passing and shooting. Flyknit material works with VNMSkin to bring your foot closer to the ball. Traction for the Field Strategically placed in the forefoot, the Cyclone 360 circular traction pattern helps you plant and pivot with speed. Natural Fit A new shoe frame gives you a more natural fit, especially in the toe box. It helps mold to your foot and brings you closer to the ball for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy Flyknit material for a secure feel. Ghost Lacing system covers your laces once you tie up to help limit distractions. More Details For use on dry, natural-grass fields Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Pro
items.description: Even Legends find ways to evolve. Made for those serious about their game, the latest iteration of these Pro cleats has all-new FlyTouch Pro engineered leather. Softer than natural leather, it conforms to your foot and works with All Conditions Control (a grippy texture even in wet weather), so you can dictate the pace of your game. Lighter and sleeker than any other Tiempo to date, the Legend 10 is for any position on the field, whether you're sending a pinpoint pass through the defense or tracking back to stop a breakaway. Amplified Touch See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. All Conditions Control (ACC) technology adds a grippy texture in both wet and dry conditions. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Pro engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. A knit inner sleeve gives you a secure feel. Traction for the Field The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your speed to the next level? We made these Academy cleats with an improved heel Air Zoom unit. It gives you the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, so you can dictate pace and tempo all match long. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous generation to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. A Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite "Kylian Mbappé"
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So is Kylian Mbappe. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you, and Kylian, the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern works with the Air Zoom unit to unlock Kylian's blazing speed. It takes up more surface area of the Air Zoom unit compared to the Vapor 15 while providing the right amount of grip. It combines with chevron and blade studs to help Kylian stop when making cuts. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit, a sticky material that provides exceptional touch to the ball, gives Kylian the control he needs when dribbling at high speeds. It provides equal grip in wet or dry conditions. Snug Fit The Flyknit upper, engineered for the game's fastest players, provides a sock-like fit. It combines with Gripknit to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing Kylian closer to the ball and shortening break-in time. More Details For use on dry, natural-grass fields Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Phantom 6 High Elite
items.description: Obsessed with accuracy? Us too. That’s why we designed the Phantom 6 Elite with revolutionary Gripknit to power your precision. The sticky texture brings your foot closer to the ball and helps put you in control of every opportunity—because missing isn’t an option. It gives you an unfair scoring advantage by combining with the Cyclone 360 traction plate for all those quick cuts. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit, a sticky texture that provides grip where you need it, gives you the control you need for ultimate precision. It provides equal grip in wet or dry conditions. Traction for the Field Strategically placed in the forefoot, the Cyclone 360 circular traction pattern helps you plant and pivot with speed. Natural Fit A new shoe frame gives you a more natural fit, especially in the toe box. It helps mold to your foot and brings you closer to the ball for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy Flyknit material for a secure feel. Ghost Lacing system covers your laces once you tie up to help limit distractions. More Details For use on dry, natural-grass fields Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Jr. Mercurial Superfly 10 Academy "Sam Kerr"
items.description: Inspired by what Sam Kerr wears on match day, this Superfly 10 Academy fuels your bursts of speed. Subtle personal details of Sam's rise to greatness combine with bouncy Air Zoom cushioning and a wave-like traction plate to help keep you at full throttle. "Be Who I Am..." “Be who you are.” Subtle personal details molded by the heel cover Sam’s journey from Perth to international superstardom. The stripe down the toe pays homage to a major sporting moment in her life, when a fellow Australian speedster dominated the 2000 world stage. Check out the sockliners for Sam’s rallying cry to the next generation of athletes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern works with the Air Zoom unit to help unlock your speed. It takes up more surface area of the Air Zoom unit compared to the Superfly 10 while providing the right amount of grip. It combines with chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making cuts. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. Snug Fit We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous iteration to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. A Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Jr. Mercurial Superfly 10 Academy LV8

Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. items.name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Jr. Mercurial Superfly 10 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your speed to the next level? We made these Academy cleats with an improved heel Air Zoom unit. It gives you the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, so you can flash your speed and put the ball in the back of the net. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. Snug Fit Pull tabs and a strap combine for a design that eliminates the need for laces and helps get you on the field fast. We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous generation to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. A Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

The Nike Jr. Superfly 10 can help you flash your speed and put the ball in the back of the net. And the synthetic leather on the upper provides grip when you dribble at high speeds. Time to take off! Soft Touch Synthetic leather on the upper has small textured details that provide grip for better ball control when dribbling at quick speeds. Fast Traction Rubber outsole provides traction on turf surfaces. Easy Fit A comfortable lining wraps your foot for a natural, close-fitting feel. More Details Classic laces For use on shorter, synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Jr. Mercurial Superfly 10 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your speed to the next level? We made these Academy cleats with an improved heel Air Zoom unit. It gives you the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, so you can flash your speed and put the ball in the back of the net. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. Snug Fit Pull tabs and a strap combine for a design that eliminates the need for laces and helps get you on the field fast. We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous generation to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. A Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Pro
items.description: Serious about your speed? Pro cleats are for those who want to push the pace all match long. That's why we made these with an improved Air Zoom unit. It gives you and those devoted to the game the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. Take your skills to the next level with some of Nike’s greatest innovations like Flyknit on the upper, which makes the cleat even lighter so you can play fast. Enhanced Touch A tacky skin finish is geared for goals and maintaining control of the ball when dribbling at high speeds. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Fit for Speed For the first time in Mercurial, we’ve developed a full Flyknit upper. It’s tuned for the needs of the game and sent through the Mercurial filter, so it’s engineered for speed. An incredibly lightweight, yet strong Flyknit on the side panels provides support and brings you closer to the ball. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Elite
items.description: Even Legends find ways to evolve. The latest iteration of these Elite cleats has all-new FlyTouch Plus engineered leather. Softer than natural leather, it conforms to your foot and works with All Conditions Control (a grippy texture even in wet weather), so you can dictate the pace of your game. Lighter and sleeker than any other Tiempo to date, the Legend 10 is for any position on the field, whether you're sending a pinpoint pass through the defense or tracking back to stop a breakaway. Amplified Touch See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. All Conditions Control (ACC) technology adds a grippy texture in both wet and dry conditions. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Plus engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. Flyknit around the ankle gives you a secure feel. Traction for the Field The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: adidas Copa Pure 3 League
items.description: Every deft touch. Every exquisite pass. Piece together your perfect game with Copa Pure 3 cleats for a flawless connection with the ball every time. These adidas League cleats have a synthetic Fusionfeel upper that looks and feels like leather. On its forefoot, a 3D print adds assurance to every touch. Underneath, a Comfortplate outsole makes for elegant soccer on multiple pitch types. Features Regular: Designed to be a standard fit, not too tight or too loose Firm Ground: Outsole designed for optimal traction on firm ground (dry natural grass) Heel Details: Increased heel foam package for extra comfort Outsole Details: FG/MG tooling providing traction on both natural grass pitches and all generations of artificial grass Comfort Plate: TPU tooling with an additional stud on the lateral for better pressure distribution. The 3 strategically placed semi-conical studs ensure traction during rotation. Upper Details: 3D haptic prints for increased ball grip Lace: Adjust the lacing to get the lockdown your foot needs Tongue Details: Padded floating tongue with a foam layer to decrease lace pressure and ensure comfort, perforations added breathability Push-Off Studs: Extra forefoot push-off studs for high performance on FG & AG pitches Material: Fusionfeel: Combines leather-like softness and strategically placed padding for enhanced comfort without sacrificing a close ball feel Details Regular fit Lace closure Fusionfeel textured synthetic upper Perforated, padded tongue Padded heel Comfortplate firm/multi-ground outsole

items.name: Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Academy
items.description: Even Legends find ways to evolve. Made to take your game to the next level, the latest iteration of these Academy shoes has all-new FlyTouch Lite engineered leather. Softer than natural leather and double-layered with mesh, it conforms to your foot, adds breathability and doesn't overstretch, so you can play with comfort and dictate the pace of your game. Lighter and sleeker than any other Tiempo to date, the Legend 10 is for any position on the field, whether you're sending a pinpoint pass through the defense or tracking back to stop a breakaway. Amplified Touch See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the court. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the shoe. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Lite engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the shoe mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. Mesh tongue with additional padding gives you a secure feel and comfort in key strike zones. Microfiber lining creates a premium feel. Traction for the Court Rubber outsole gives you traction for street, court and indoor surfaces. More Details For use on street, court and indoor surfaces Soft, springy foam midsole Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Jr. Mercurial Superfly 10 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your speed to the next level? We made these Academy cleats with an improved heel Air Zoom unit. It gives you the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, so you can flash your speed and put the ball in the back of the net. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. Snug Fit Pull tabs and a strap combine for a design that eliminates the need for laces and helps get you on the field fast. We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous generation to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. A Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

Softer than natural leather, it conforms to your foot and works with All Conditions Control (a grippy texture even in wet weather), so you can dictate the pace of your game. Lighter and sleeker than any other Tiempo to date, the Legend 10 is for any position on the field, whether you're sending a pinpoint pass through the defense or tracking back to stop a breakaway. Amplified Touch See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. All Conditions Control (ACC) technology adds a grippy texture in both wet and dry conditions. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Plus engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. Flyknit around the ankle gives you a secure feel. Traction for the Field The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your speed to the next level? We made these Academy cleats with an improved heel Air Zoom unit. It gives you the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, so you can dictate pace and tempo all match long. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous generation to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Phantom Luna 2 Academy
items.description: Looking to take your game to the next level? The Phantom Luna 2 Academy helps put you in prime position of the net, whether you're the organizer, assister or finisher. The rest is up to you. Created with goals in mind, NikeSkin covers the striking area of the shoe while sticky traction helps guide your unscripted agility on the turf. Amplified Touch We expanded the NikeSkin touch zone from the previous version. This brings your foot even closer to the ball for better control while dribbling and passing in wet or dry conditions. It covers the striking area of the shoe, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. Quick Traction An integrated traction pattern helps you make quick and confident movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up on the turf. Fit for the Field The cuff offers soft comfort around your ankle and heel. Subtle ribs in the cuff allow for ball contact higher up the ankle in trapping and passing. More Details For use on shorter, synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

Easy Fit A comfortable lining wraps your foot for a natural, close-fitting feel. More Details Classic laces For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

items.description: Put the world on notice with the Nike United Vapor 16 Academy. Designed for the fastest players on the field, like Lauren James and Salma Paralluelo, this bold new colorway features bouncy Air Zoom cushioning and an aggressive traction plate for game-changing speed. Inspired by athletes like Lauren James and Salma Paralluelo, our designers used bold colors and disruptive graphics representing the tenacity and ambition it takes to reach the top. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern works with the Air Zoom unit to help unlock your speed. It takes up more surface area of the Air Zoom unit compared to the Vapor 15 while providing the right amount of grip. It combines with chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making cuts. Snug Fit We’ve upgraded the stretch mesh from the previous generation to an adaptable knit that offers flexibility, provides support and brings you closer to the ball. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved chevron and blade studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Phantom Luna 2 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with perfecting your craft? We made this for you. In the middle of the storm, with chaos swirling all around you, you’ve calmly found the final third of the field, thanks to your uncanny mix of on-ball guile and grace. Go finish the job in the Phantom Luna 2 Elite. Revolutionary Nike Gripknit covers the striking area of the cleat while Nike Cyclone 360 traction helps guide your unscripted agility. We design Elite cleats for you and the world’s biggest stars to give you high-level quality, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides exceptional touch to the ball. It covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you great grip in wet or dry conditions. Micro-molding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Quick Traction Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quicker (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Snug Fit Asymmetric lacing offers a large touch surface when dribbling, passing and scoring. A repositioned lacing pattern allows for increased midfoot adjustability to accommodate players with flatter or higher arches. Asymmetrical Flyknit cuff material provides snugness and shape around your ankle. Subtle ribs in the cuff allow for ball contact higher up the ankle in trapping and passing. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. More Details For use on longer, artificial-grass surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Pro
items.description: Even Legends find ways to evolve. Made for those serious about their game, the latest iteration of these Pro cleats has all-new FlyTouch Pro engineered leather. Softer than natural leather, it conforms to your foot and works with All Conditions Control (a grippy texture even in wet weather), so you can dictate the pace of your game. Lighter and sleeker than any other Tiempo to date, the Legend 10 is for any position on the field, whether you're sending a pinpoint pass through the defense or tracking back to stop a breakaway. Amplified Touch See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. All Conditions Control (ACC) technology adds a grippy texture in both wet and dry conditions. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Pro engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. A knit inner sleeve gives you a secure feel. Traction for the Field The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions. More Details For use on longer, artificial-grass surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite
items.description: Obsessed with speed? So are the game's biggest stars. That's why we made these Elite cleats with an improved 3/4-length Air Zoom unit. It gives you and the sport's fastest players the propulsive feel needed to break through the back line. The result is the most responsive Mercurial we've ever made, because you demand greatness from yourself and your footwear. Exceptional Touch Nike Gripknit is a sticky material that provides better touch to the ball. It takes up more surface area, so you have more room to control the ball when dribbling at high speeds or finish a play with a shot on goal. It molds to the shape of your foot and gives you equal grip in wet or dry conditions for a sculpted, track spike-like fit. Micromolding texture works with Gripknit to help form to your foot for even better cleat-to-ball strikes. Fast Traction The wave-like traction pattern is a series of cascading studs, so it engages more surface area of the Air Zoom unit while also providing the appropriate amount of grip. The biggest stud is the same height as our traditional middle studs, so traction is not compromised. We paired the wave-like traction with evolved studs to help you stop when making quick cuts. Snug Fit The full Flyknit upper is engineered for speed. Atomknit, an incredibly lightweight and strong Flyknit, on the sides tapers weight and provides support. The Gripknit, Atomknit and Flyknit combine to form the thinnest Mercurial upper to date, bringing you closer to the ball and lessening break-in time. The Dynamic Fit collar wraps your ankle in soft, stretchy fabric for a secure feel. More Details For use on longer, artificial-grass surfaces Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Tiempo Emerald Legend 10 Pro
items.description: Serious about your game? We make Pro cleats for those looking to take their game to the next level. Celebrating 30 years of Tiempo, this Legend 10 references old Tiempo elements that are part of Nike’s DNA along with futuristic textures and graphics. Add in FlyTouch Pro and All Conditions Control (a grippy texture even in wet weather), and you’re ready to leave your mark over the next three decades. Touch for All Conditions See those microdots on the upper? They amplify touch zones for shooting, dribbling and passing. They make for a sleeker look while taking out the extra padding. Even better, they don't sacrifice the ball control you crave on the field. We shaved down the foam pods from the Tiempo 9, so your foot can get even closer to the ball when it’s in your control. Instead, we molded the lines into the cleat. All Conditions Control (ACC) technology adds a grippy texture in both wet and dry conditions. Natural, Conforming Fit FlyTouch Pro engineered leather is incredibly soft. It helps the cleat mold to your foot for comfort without overstretching the material. A knit inner sleeve gives you a secure feel. Traction for the Field The plate blends conical studs in the heel for optimal traction and stability when braking and changing direction, just right under any conditions. More Details For use on slightly wet, short-grass fields Cushioned insole

items.name: Nike Jr. Phantom GX 2 Academy "Erling Haaland"
items.description: Erling Haaland is inevitable. His goal-scoring force of nature inspired the design of these player-edition cleats, with supernovas and meteors crashing into the graphics. Combined with sticky NikeSkin technology, the Phantom GX 2 Academy gives you the precision you need to find the back of the net. Behind the Design The dark blues represent the wintertime skies of Erling’s native Norway, while the vibrant orange embodies the brightness that the nature brings. The upper’s shiny finish symbolizes the stars in the sky and the infinite number of goals Erling has scored throughout his illustrious career. Amplified Touch We expanded the NikeSkin touch zone from the previous version. This brings your foot even closer to the ball for better control while dribbling and passing in wet or dry conditions. It covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. Quick Traction Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quick (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Comfortable Fit The soft upper helps keep you comfortable from kickoff to the final minute. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned insole

In the middle of the storm, with chaos swirling all around you, you’ve calmly found the final third of the field, thanks to your uncanny mix of on-ball guile and grace. items.name: Nike United Phantom Luna 2 Academy
items.description: Put the world on notice with the Nike United Phantom Luna 2 Academy. Designed for unstoppably accurate stars like Sophia Wilson and Deyna Castellanos, it combines sticky NikeSkin for precise ball control and the Nike Cyclone 360 plate underfoot for quick cuts. Behind the Design: Nike United The Nike United Pack celebrates the stars who shine when the game is on the line. Inspired by athletes like Sophia Wilson and Deyna Castellanos, our designers used bold colors and disruptive graphics representing the tenacity and ambition it takes to reach the top. Amplified Touch We expanded the NikeSkin touch zone from the previous version. This brings your foot even closer to the ball for better control while dribbling and passing in wet or dry conditions. It covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. Quick Traction Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quick (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Comfortable Fit The soft upper with mesh collar helps keep you comfortable from kickoff to the final minute. More Details For use on natural and synthetic surfaces Cushioned sockliner

items.name: Nike Phantom GX 2 Pro
items.description: Serious about your game? We made this for you. In the middle of the storm, with chaos swirling all around you, you’ve calmly found the final third of the field, thanks to your uncanny mix of on-ball guile and grace. Go finish the job in the Phantom GX 2 Pro. Take your skills to the next level with some of Nike’s greatest innovations, like a stretchy Flyknit upper and Nike Cyclone 360 traction guiding your unscripted agility. Touch for All Conditions A grippy overlay covers the striking area of the cleat, stretching from the big-toe side all the way across the laces to the pinky toe, allowing clean boot-to-ball kicks. The material helps give you control in damp and dry weather. Quick Traction Nike Cyclone 360 traction pattern helps you make quicker (improved agility when making cuts) and confident (helps reduce rotational traction) movements, so you can cut with speed while feeling fully secure when the game's intensity turns up. Snug Fit Flyknit material provides snugness and shape to help provide comfort around the collar. More Details For use on longer, artificial-grass surfaces Cushioned insole

Designed for the fastest players on the field, like Lauren James and Salma Paralluelo, this bold new colorway features bouncy Air Zoom cushioning for game-changing speed. Behind the Design: Nike United The Nike United Pack celebrates the stars who shine when the game is on the line. Inspired by athletes like Lauren James and Salma Paralluelo, our designers used bold colors and disruptive graphics representing the tenacity and ambition it takes to reach the top. Amplified Touch The upper is made of NikeSkin with embedded chevrons, which helps provide ball control and truly gives you a feeling of barefoot soccer.
